Line regulation is 4.5× over spec and PSRR at 1 kHz is 9 dB short, so the error amplifier's DC gain is the limit. Its output impedance is set by the single PMOS mirror (M3/M4 gds). Refining the parameters can't recover about 14 dB, so this edit changes the program:

- **Cascoded load.** The PMOS mirror becomes a low-voltage cascode. Its gate bias `pc` comes from a resistor tied to `vin`, so it tracks the supply and helps PSRR.
- **Pass device.** Default pass-device length goes up from 0.2 to 0.3 µm to lower its gds.
- **Compensation.** Default `Cc` drops from 36 pF to 22 pF to raise loop gain at 1 kHz. Undershoot (87 mV against a 140 mV limit) leaves room for this.
- **Quiescent current.** The cascode bias adds 3 µA. With `I_div` lowered to 10 µA, the estimate is about 74 µA against the 83 µA limit.

The main risk is headroom at node `g` at minimum load, which the design targets at roughly 0.05–0.08 V of margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Line reg 4.5x over and PSRR 9 dB short: EA DC gain limited by uncascoded PMOS mirror. Add low-voltage PMOS cascode load biased by vin-referenced resistor, longer pass L, smaller Cc for more 1 kHz loop gain."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gm_in":  (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "I_tail": (16e-6, 8e-6, 24e-6),
    "I_cas":  (16e-6, 8e-6, 22e-6),
    "Cc":     (22e-12, 8e-12, 60e-12),
    "Cm":     (4e-12, 1e-12, 15e-12),
    "gm_pass": (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_pass": (0.3, 0.15, 0.5),
    "I_div":  (10e-6, 4e-6, 16e-6),
    "L_load": (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "v_fold": (0.25, 0.18, 0.40),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    vout_t = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)

    It, Ic, Idv, vf = p["I_tail"], p["I_cas"], p["I_div"], p["v_fold"]
    Ib = It / 2 + Ic
    Ipb = 3e-6
    Ipc = 3e-6

    beta = vref / vout_t
    Rtot = vout_t / Idv
    R2 = Rtot * beta
    R1 = Rtot - R2

    m_in = lut.size("p", p["gm_in"], 1.0, It / 2, vds=0.9, vsb=0.0)
    vtl = vref + m_in.vgs
    vsd_in = vtl - vf
    m_in = lut.size("p", p["gm_in"], 1.0, It / 2, vds=max(vsd_in, 0.2), vsb=0.0)
    vtl = vref + m_in.vgs
    vsd_tail = vin - vtl

    m_pb = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ipb, vds=1.0)
    m_pb = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Ipb, vds=m_pb.vgs)
    m_t = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, It, vds=max(vsd_tail, 0.1))

    m_d = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    m_d = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=m_d.vgs)
    m_bot = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=vf)
    m_nb = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ipb, vds=vin - m_pb.vgs)

    m_c = lut.size("n", 20, 0.5, Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=vf)
    vcas = vf + m_c.vgs
    Rb = max((vcas - m_d.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # PMOS low-voltage cascode mirror load
    vsd_l = 0.0
    m_l = lut.size("p", 10, p["L_load"], Ic, vds=0.25)
    vsd_l = m_l.vdsat + 0.06
    m_l = lut.size("p", 10, p["L_load"], Ic, vds=vsd_l)
    m_lc = lut.size("p", 15, 0.5, Ic, vds=0.3, vsb=vsd_l)
    vpc_drop = vsd_l + m_lc.vgs          # vin - pc
    Rpc = vpc_drop / Ipc
    m_nc = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ipc, vds=vin - vpc_drop)

    m_p = lut.size("p", p["gm_pass"], p["L_pass"], imax + Idv, vds=vin - vout_t)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.R("Rb", "ibias", "nd", Rb)
    n.dev("Mb0", "nd", "nd", "vss", "vss", m_d)
    n.dev("Mnb", "pb", "nd", "vss", "vss", m_nb)
    n.dev("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", m_pb)
    n.dev("Mt", "tl", "pb", "vin", "vin", m_t)
    n.R("Rpc", "vin", "pc", Rpc)
    n.dev("Mnc", "pc", "nd", "vss", "vss", m_nc)
    n.dev("M1", "f1", "fb", "tl", "tl", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "f2", "vref", "tl", "tl", m_in)
    n.dev("Mbot1", "f1", "nd", "vss", "vss", m_bot)
    n.dev("Mbot2", "f2", "nd", "vss", "vss", m_bot)
    n.dev("Mc1", "d3", "ibias", "f1", "vss", m_c)
    n.dev("Mc2", "g", "ibias", "f2", "vss", m_c)
    n.dev("M3", "x3", "d3", "vin", "vin", m_l)
    n.dev("M3c", "d3", "pc", "x3", "vin", m_lc)
    n.dev("M4", "x4", "d3", "vin", "vin", m_l)
    n.dev("M4c", "g", "pc", "x4", "vin", m_lc)
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", m_p, m=10)
    n.C("Cc", "vout", "f2", p["Cc"])
    n.C("Cm", "g", "vout", p["Cm"])
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    gm1 = m_in.gm
    rn = m_c.gm / max(m_c.gds, 1e-12) / max(m_bot.gds + m_in.gds, 1e-12)
    rp = m_lc.gm / max(m_lc.gds, 1e-12) / max(m_l.gds, 1e-12)
    g_out = 1.0 / rn + 1.0 / rp
    A = gm1 / g_out
    Ab = A * beta
    line = m_p.gds / (m_p.gm * Ab) + 1.0 / (Ab * 50)
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    Cm_tot = p["Cm"] + 0.3e-15 * m_p.W
    psrr_lin = w1k * Cm_tot / (gm1 * beta) + line
    dvg = 1.4 * UT * math.log(imax / (imin + Idv))
    load_reg = (dvg / Ab) / (imax - imin) + 1.0 / (Ab * m_p.gm)
    iq = iref + It + 2 * Ic + Ipb + Ipc + Idv
    gm_lo = 14.0 * (imin + Idv)
    Cg_t = m_p.cgg + p["Cm"]
    ugb = gm1 * beta / (p["Cc"] + p["Cm"])
    w_in = gm_lo * (p["Cc"] + p["Cm"]) / (Cg_t * cl)
    dv_fast = 0.25 * Cg_t / p["Cc"]
    undershoot = dv_fast + 0.04
    g_max = vin - vsd_l - m_lc.vdsat

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 100.0 / Ab,
        "line_reg": line,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "psrr_1k": -db(psrr_lin),
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
        "ea_gain_db": db(A),
        "ugb_rad": ugb,
        "inner_pole_rad": w_in,
        "p3_rad": m_c.gm / p["Cc"],
        "vsd_tail": vsd_tail,
        "vcas": vcas,
        "g_max": g_max,
        "pc": vin - vpc_drop,
        "pass_W": m_p.W,
    }
```
